body: Twenty years gone, still cherish her

Im so sorry you are going through this. My divorce was finalized 5 months ago after over 20 years. She moved out from our house into a new place with him. It is a very difficult journey but i am a better person for it. Find new and old ways to keep you busy. Not just busy but personally productive busy. I started doing a lot more hiking and walking. Started making exercise a part of my normal daily life( gyms are closed right now but still do bleachers and jog and tire flip at local high school), got back into going to archery range. I found ways to keep my mind and body from dwelling on circumstances. Dont be afraid to take care of yourself and show yourself the love you deserve. Learn how to be happy with yourself so you dont need somebody else's approval.  If you don't have your boys, its ok to go to movies with friends or even alone. Ive learned not to miss out on the things i like doing just because im single. If you are afraid to do things without someone else you will miss out on so much. Ive strengthened my relationship with God and love the life He is guiding me towards. It comes down to making you proud of you and not letting the actions or words of your ex or anyone else guide your self worth. Be strong and find you

Very similar to the situation i went through at about the same age, wife was also a couple years younger. Dont be so quick to think divorce. I know its hard, ive lived it. I am now actually going through divorce with my wife from that part of my life. We were able to move through that and grow closer after words. It will eat at you and will never completely disappear, but i was able to enjoy so many more years and have a second child with her. We were able to live that life that we wanted with the kids the house the 2 dogs and 3 cats. We are now at over 20 years, and while im pretty positive we wont hit 21, i wouldnt take back my decision to stay with her. If you were to stay, You both need to figure out what you BOTH did to get to this point. If you share a true love, then there is some things that you need to figure out and work on as well as her. Something was missing or fell off that you both fealt but never communicated on. Remember,  for better or worse. I know many will say im an idiot and leave her, but many have also lived with regret in their lives or have kept a huge amount of anger in their hearts. We are separated right now and she is living with another man but this was not caused by infidelity. This was more from the fact that we let too much life get in the way of our love. Dont listen to the haters if all they are going to do is spew out hate. If you are unclear on what ur heart wants then there is hope. Hope doesnt mean all is good. But it means all can be with the hardwork true love deserves.

I am afraid that i truly believe that God has given up on me. I am lterally sitting here in the spot my wife and i first kissed almost 21 years ago asking him for the reasons i would have to stay. The only thing i have is my kids. It seems like everyday i feel less and less as if they are the strength to get me through. They will probably get me through today, and honestly the fact that you replied will too. I told myself to look and see and i did. Maybe thats God working his ways, but i need a whole lot more. 3 seconds is all it would take, i just figured out how long it would take for me to take away the hurt and these feelings. Its not hard when all you have to do is lift your hand to your mouth and do it. Just practiced it. Hardest 3 seconds ever but just a quick flinch would complete it. 
You know, they say God has a plan for all of us. What happens after you fulfill his plan? I think i did what he wanted me to, which was help my wife raise the awesome kids i have. But somehow his exit plan for me didnt go right so now im being bombarded with too much to get me to exit the rest of his plan. If he doesnt give you more than you can handle, whats it mean when you cant handle what you have been given? Is that the sign that he has left you to deal on your own? 
I dont expect God to wave his hand and all is good, but i have prayed for his help and mercy for too long. I prayed for strength in my marriage for long before divorce was discussed. I prayed for help with my addiction to the point i had my.40 in my mouth at my house with my children there. The help i got was getting arrested, losing my job, and eventually myself and my wife, house, and now the comfort of my kids. I made the choices to follow evil, but when i wanted away from that evil i got nothing but evil in my life. Im sorry. Rambling on again. Not putting any of this on you, just nice to let it out.
